question: Which of the following options is NOT used to perform the next animation or advance to the next slide in MS PowerPoint?
solution:

In MS PowerPoint, several keys and key combinations are commonly used to perform the next animation or advance to the next slide during a presentation. The options provided in the question are:

 
• 1) Enter
 
• 2) Shift + F5
 
• 3) N
 
• 4) Page Down

The correct answer is option 2 (Shift + F5).
